panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Coronal abdominal CT from a pediatric patient with idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis shows the captioned pelvic fibrotic mass, marked by an asterisk. The mass is a specific manifestation of the target disease, although the available vocabulary has no key for a pelvic fibrotic mass. [raw subtype: idiopathic pediatric retroperitoneal fibrosis] B: Coronal MRI from a pediatric retroperitoneal fibrosis case visibly demonstrates bilateral hydronephrosis, explicitly identified by arrows in the caption. [raw subtype: idiopathic pediatric retroperitoneal fibrosis]

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: EUS-guided biopsy of the peripancreatic mass shows dense hyalinized fibrosis and plasma-cell inflammation in a case explicitly diagnosed as IgG4-related retroperitoneal fibrosis. [raw subtype: IgG4-related] B: CD138 immunohistochemistry demonstrates increased plasma cells in the patient’s peripancreatic biopsy, supporting the IgG4-related retroperitoneal fibrosis described in the case. [raw subtype: IgG4-related] C: MUM-1 immunohistochemistry demonstrates increased plasma cells in the patient’s peripancreatic biopsy, a manifestation reported in this IgG4-related retroperitoneal fibrosis case. [raw subtype: IgG4-related] D: IgG4 immunohistochemistry directly demonstrates the IgG4-positive plasma-cell infiltrate characteristic of the reported IgG4-related retroperitoneal fibrosis. [raw subtype: IgG4-related]
